19 goals | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | total goals = | average goals = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2007 Uzbek League|2007]] | nextseason = [[2009 Uzbek League|2009]] }} The '''2008 [[Uzbek League]] season''' was the 17th edition of top level football in [[Uzbekistan]] since independence from the [[Soviet Union]] in 1992. ==Overview== It was contested by 16 teams, and [[FC Bunyodkor|Bunyodkor]] won the championship. [[Traktor Tashkent]] and ''Tupalang Sariosiyo'' withdrew of 2008 season participation because of financial problems. They were replaced by and [[Olmaliq FK|OTMK Olmaliq]], a team from First League, and [[Metallurg Bekabad]] which as of 2008 season end, was originally relegated to First League, remained in top division. [[Sogdiana Jizzakh]] and ''Uz-Dong-Joo'' promoted from First League.
